reading.body:
CyrusOne Cincinnati (CIN2) publishes 11 MW of IT capacity across 143,778 square feet of technical space, with compliance certifications for PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, and SSAE 16 Type II.

The certifications indicate the facility is built for regulated financial, healthcare, and federal workloads, not for the open-ended compute demands of frontier AI training. Its 11 MW of IT capacity is a power figure that constrains how many GPU clusters can run simultaneously, but the data does not state rack density or GPU count.

The record does not include an announced expansion, so the 11 MW figure may represent current capacity only. The suitability score of 57 is based only on published IT capacity and operator type, and it omits announced expansion, so it should not be read as a full assessment of AI readiness.
